source.title: Accounting Software Taxonomy v1
source.notes: Canonical taxonomy substrate for PAT. This artifact now anchors the research-backed product utility registry implemented in lib/productUtilityRegistry.ts. Vendor and product arrays remain intentionally empty until grounded market/vendor data is added.

patProductUtilityRegistry.notes: Canonical PAT utility-family coverage for reusable vendor, firm, and individual product assessments.
